spans.text: Ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde ahupoo anaa nneyɛɛ a ɛnnam mmara kwan soɔ gye obi agyapadeɛ firi ne nsam kwa.

folded.object: boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtena ase asomdwoeɛ ne ahofadie mu a bɔne biara nka ne nipadua no.

spans.text: Sɛ awareɛ no bɛsɔ a, gye sɛ awarefoɔ baanu no apene so, agye ato wɔn ho so sɛ wɔbɛware.

folded.subject: berɛ

spans.text: Sɛ wɔbɔ obi kwaadu wɔ biribi ho na wɔde onii kɔ asɛnniiɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔbɛdi asɛm no bu atɛntenenee, berɛ a wɔnkyea wɔn aso.

spans.text: Afei obiara nso tumi fo ɔkwan biara so bɔ biribi ho dawuro de kyerɛ n'adwene anaa ɔtumi hwehwɛ nya biribi ho adwene a ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔyɛ ɔman ba anaa ɔnana.

folded.id: kasa|a|obi ka
folded.subject: Kasa

spans.text: Kasa a obi ka, asɔre a obi kɔ, amanyɔkuo ko a obi dɔm, deɛ obi fire, adwapadeɛ a ɔwɔ, n'awosuom ne deɛ ɛkeka ho nsi obiara kwan wɔ saa nhyehyɛɛ yi ho.

folded.id: kɔ asɛm|no|mu
folded.subject: kɔ asɛm

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde so to obi so, nam so kye no, na wɔntumi mfeefee asɛm no mu, nhunuu nokorɛ a ɛwɔ mu a, yɛfa no sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no, gye sɛ wɔnam mmara kwan so, kɔ asɛm no mu, hunu sɛ ɔdi fɔ.

folded.id: kuo bi|a|ɔmpɛ
folded.subject: kuo bi

spans.text: Ɛnsɛ sɛ obiara hyɛ obiara ma ɔdɔm kuo bi a ɔmpɛ.

folded.id: ma nnipa|ne|amanaman nyinaa
folded.subject: ma nnipa

spans.text: Saa adasamma Yiedie Ho Anodisɛm a wɔada no adie yi bɛyɛ susudua titire baako pɛ a, ɛwɔ hɔ ma nnipa ne amanaman nyinaa, na Ɔkɔntɛkorɔ anaa fekuo ahodoɔ nyinaa bɛma adi wɔn tirim dɛm, abɔ no dawuro akyerɛkyerɛ aseɛ yie pa ara, agye ato mu, adi so, na wɔde afa wɔn ankasa aman ne aman foforɔ dwumadie nhyehyɛɛ ahodɔ so ama ahyeta aman a wɔdɔm Amanaman Nkabom Kuo ne aman biara a ɛhyɛ n'ase mu.

folded.id: manfoɔ reteetee|no|apɛ no atɔre n'ase a
folded.subject: manfoɔ reteetee

spans.text: Sɛ obi manfoɔ reteetee no apɛ no atɔre n'ase a, ɛyɛ n'asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔdwane kɔ dwankɔbea bi wɔ ɔman foforɔ bi mu kɔbɔ ne ho adwaa wɔ hɔ.

folded.id: mfeefee asɛm|no|mu
folded.subject: mfeefee asɛm

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde so to obi so, nam so kye no, na wɔntumi mfeefee asɛm no mu, nhunuu nokorɛ a ɛwɔ mu a, yɛfa no sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no, gye sɛ wɔnam mmara kwan so, kɔ asɛm no mu, hunu sɛ ɔdi fɔ.

folded.id: mmara so|de|asotwe a ɛmfata ma obi wɔ bɔne bi a onii yɛe berɛ a na saa mmara no nni hɔ ho
folded.subject: mmara so
folded.object: asotwe a ɛmfata ma obi wɔ bɔne bi a onii yɛe berɛ a na saa mmara no nni hɔ ho

spans.text: Obiara nni ho kwan sɛ ɔgyina amammara anaa amanaman mmara so de asotwe a ɛmfata ma obi wɔ bɔne bi a onii yɛe berɛ a na saa mmara no nni hɔ ho.

folded.id: mmara|mu|deɛ
folded.subject: Mmara

spans.text: Mmara mu deɛ, yɛnhwɛ obiara anim.

folded.id: mmoa biara|a|ɔbɛtumi anya de atete ne ho akyiri kwan
folded.subject: mmoa biara
folded.object: ɔbɛtumi anya de atete ne ho akyiri kwan

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde no kɔ asɛnniiɛ mpo koraa a, ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔhwehwɛ mmoa biara a ɔbɛtumi anya de atete ne ho akyiri kwan.

folded.id: n'awosuom|ne|deɛ ɛkeka ho nsi obiara kwan wɔ saa nhyehyɛɛ yi ho
folded.subject: n'awosuom
folded.object: deɛ ɛkeka ho nsi obiara kwan wɔ saa nhyehyɛɛ yi ho

spans.text: Kasa a obi ka, asɔre a obi kɔ, amanyɔkuo ko a obi dɔm, deɛ obi fire, adwapadeɛ a ɔwɔ, n'awosuom ne deɛ ɛkeka ho nsi obiara kwan wɔ saa nhyehyɛɛ yi ho.

folded.id: na obiara|a|wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe biara to bie so na ɛdɛdi saa dwuma yi
folded.subject: na obiara
folded.object: wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe biara to bie so na ɛdɛdi saa dwuma yi

spans.text: Wɔnam abatoɔ a dwinim biara nni mu, na obi nhunu ne yɔnko abatoɔ mu, na obiara a wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe biara to bie so na ɛdɛdi saa dwuma yi.

folded.id: nhunuu nokorɛ|a|ɛwɔ mu a
folded.subject: nhunuu nokorɛ

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde so to obi so, nam so kye no, na wɔntumi mfeefee asɛm no mu, nhunuu nokorɛ a ɛwɔ mu a, yɛfa no sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no, gye sɛ wɔnam mmara kwan so, kɔ asɛm no mu, hunu sɛ ɔdi fɔ.

folded.id: nkabom kuo|mu|nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ amammuo nnyinasoɔ no mu
folded.subject: Nkabom Kuo
folded.object: nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

folded.id: nkoatɔ|ne|nkoatɔn yɛ dwadie bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtɔre aseɛ korakora
folded.subject: Nkoatɔ
folded.object: nkoatɔn yɛ dwadie bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtɔre aseɛ korakora

spans.text: Nkoatɔ ne nkoatɔn yɛ dwadie bi a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtɔre aseɛ korakora.

folded.id: nnipa ahonim|de|asetena foforɔ aba
folded.subject: nnipa ahonim

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ atuateɛ ne obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ, na abɛhwanyane nnipa ahonim de asetena foforɔ aba, ama nnipa ani aba wɔn ho so sɛ wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔka wɔn adwene a ehu biara nni mu, na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyɔ adwuma na ɛnhia wɔn, na ɛsiane sɛ wɔapae mu aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti,

folded.id: nnɔbaeɛ|ne|amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ
folded.subject: nnɔbaeɛ
folded.object: amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnam ɔman no ahoɔden anaa nkabom bi a saa ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ, di yie sɛdeɛ ɔman ko no sikasɛm, nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ.

folded.id: ntease pa|a|yɛbɛnya no wɔ anodisɛm a ɛfa onipa yiedie ne n'ahofadie ho bɛma yɛn bɔhyɛ yi adi mu nti
folded.subject: ntease pa
folded.object: yɛbɛnya no wɔ anodisɛm a ɛfa onipa yiedie ne n'ahofadie ho bɛma yɛn bɔhyɛ yi adi mu nti

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ ntease pa a yɛbɛnya no wɔ anodisɛm a ɛfa onipa yiedie ne n'ahofadie ho bɛma yɛn bɔhyɛ yi adi mu nti,

folded.id: ntumi mmɔ|ne|tirim
folded.subject: ntumi mmɔ

spans.text: Obiara ntumi mmɔ ne tirim, mfa asisie kwan so nsakra obi nkyi.

folded.id: ntumi nsi|ne|yiedie ho kwan
folded.subject: ntumi nsi

spans.text: Mmmara bɔ onipa biara ho ban sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a, biribiara ntumi nsi ne yiedie ho kwan.

folded.id: nya|ne|so ne n'akatua a ɛbɛtumi ama ɔne ne hokafoɔ ne ne mma atena ase anigyeɛ mu
folded.subject: nya
folded.object: so ne n'akatua a ɛbɛtumi ama ɔne ne hokafoɔ ne ne mma atena ase anigyeɛ mu

spans.text: Ɛyɛ onipa biara asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma biara a ɔpɛ, nya ne so ne n'akatua a ɛbɛtumi ama ɔne ne hokafoɔ ne ne mma atena ase anigyeɛ mu, sɛ nnipa, na sɛ ɛyere so koraa a, aban boa no kwan bi so de bɔ ne ho ban firi ahokyere bi

folded.id: obi nhunu|ne|yɔnko abatoɔ mu
folded.subject: obi nhunu

spans.text: Wɔnam abatoɔ a dwinim biara nni mu, na obi nhunu ne yɔnko abatoɔ mu, na obiara a wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe biara to bie so na ɛdɛdi saa dwuma yi.

folded.id: obiara dɔ|ne|yɔnko
folded.subject: obiara dɔ

spans.text: Ɛno nti, ɛsɛ sɛ obiara dɔ ne yɔnko, bu ne yɔnko, di ne yɔnko ni.

folded.id: onii|no|tumi kɔ mu tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi
folded.subject: Onii
folded.object: tumi kɔ mu tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi

spans.text: Onii no tumi kɔ mu tee anaa ɔtumi fa abatoɔ a emu da hɔ kwan so ka bi.

folded.id: ɔman biara|a|obi firi mu ho
folded.subject: ɔman biara

spans.text: Deɛ ɛka ho ne sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛto ɔman biara a obi firi mu ho, sɛ ɔman ko no di ne ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase.

folded.id: ɔman biara|mu|a ne man ka ho
folded.subject: ɔman biara

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtumi tu firi ɔman biara mu a ne man ka ho, sane ba ne man mu bio.

folded.id: ɔman ko|no|di ne ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase
folded.subject: ɔman ko
folded.object: di ne ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase

spans.text: Deɛ ɛka ho ne sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ yɛto ɔman biara a obi firi mu ho, sɛ ɔman ko no di ne ho so anaa ɛhyɛ ɔman foforɔ bi ase.
Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnam ɔman no ahoɔden anaa nkabom bi a saa ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ, di yie sɛdeɛ ɔman ko no sikasɛm, nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ.

folded.id: ɔman ko|no|sikasɛm
folded.subject: ɔman ko

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ ɛnam ɔman no ahoɔden anaa nkabom bi a saa ɔman no ne ɔman foforɔ bi ayɔ so ma ɔman ba biara nya anigyeɛ, di yie sɛdeɛ ɔman ko no sikasɛm, nnɔbaeɛ ne amammerɛ a ɛtumi ma onipa di mu no teɛ.

folded.id: ɔnya|ne|so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ
folded.subject: ɔnya

spans.text: Onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ biribiara a ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no, ɔnya ne so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

folded.id: ɔsakra berɛ|a|akwansideɛ biara nni mu
folded.subject: ɔsakra berɛ

spans.text: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔsakra ne nkyi nso a, ɛyɛ n'asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔsakra berɛ a akwansideɛ biara nni mu.
Ɛyɛ onipa biara asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔtumi ka n'adwene wɔ biribiri ho berɛ a akwansideɛ biara nni mu.

folded.id: ɔtumi nso|ne|afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ
folded.subject: Ɔtumi nso
folded.object: afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ

spans.text: Ɔtumi nso ne afoforɔ bom ne wɔn pɛ agyapadeɛ.

folded.id: pae|mu|ka sɛ:
folded.subject: pae

spans.text: pae mu ka sɛ:

folded.id: sane ba|ne|man mu bio
folded.subject: sane ba

spans.text: Obiara wɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtumi tu firi ɔman biara mu a ne man ka ho, sane ba ne man mu bio.

folded.id: sesa n'asɔre|ne|ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu
folded.subject: sesa n'asɔre
folded.object: ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu

spans.text: Saa tumi yi ma kwan ma obi tumi sesa n'asɔre ne ne gyidie wɔ badwam anaa kɔkoam a akwansideɛ biara mma mu, na ɛmfa ho nso sɛ wɔyɛ nnipa bebree anaa ɔyɛ ɔkɔntɛkorɔ.

folded.id: sɛ asɛnnifoɔ|no|yɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm no mu koraa
folded.subject: sɛ asɛnnifoɔ
folded.object: yɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm no mu koraa

spans.text: Ɛsɛ sɛ asɛnnifoɔ no yɛ nnipa a wɔn ho nni asɛm no mu koraa.

folded.id: sɛ asotwe|a|onii yɛɛ saa bɔne no na ɛwo hɔ dada no ara na wɔde twe no
folded.subject: sɛ asotwe
folded.object: onii yɛɛ saa bɔne no na ɛwo hɔ dada no ara na wɔde twe no

spans.text: Na sɛ ɛkɔba no sɛ na asotwe bi wɔ hɔ ansa na asotwe foforɔ a emu yɛ den sene dada no reba a, ɛsɛ sɛ asotwe a onii yɛɛ saa bɔne no na ɛwo hɔ dada no ara na wɔde twe no.

folded.id: sɛ atuateɛ|ne|obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ
folded.subject: sɛ atuateɛ
folded.object: obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ atuateɛ ne obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ, na abɛhwanyane nnipa ahonim de asetena foforɔ aba, ama nnipa ani aba wɔn ho so sɛ wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔka wɔn adwene a ehu biara nni mu, na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyɔ adwuma na ɛnhia wɔn, na ɛsiane sɛ wɔapae mu aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti,

folded.id: sɛ awareɛ|no|bɛsɔ a
folded.subject: Sɛ awareɛ

spans.text: Sɛ awareɛ no bɛsɔ a, gye sɛ awarefoɔ baanu no apene so, agye ato wɔn ho so sɛ wɔbɛware.

folded.id: sɛ biribiara|a|ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no
folded.subject: sɛ biribiara
folded.object: ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no

spans.text: Onipa biara wɔ ho kwan sɛ biribiara a ne man mu aban bɛyɔ no, ɔnya ne so ne deɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

folded.id: sɛ ɛba|no|sɛ obi de ahomteɛ bɛyɛ nneyɛɛ bi a ɛyɛ nneyɛɛ a ɛtwa toɔ koraa
folded.subject: sɛ ɛba
folded.object: sɛ obi de ahomteɛ bɛyɛ nneyɛɛ bi a ɛyɛ nneyɛɛ a ɛtwa toɔ koraa

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛba no sɛ obi de ahomteɛ bɛyɛ nneyɛɛ bi a ɛyɛ nneyɛɛ a ɛtwa toɔ koraa, a onii bɛtumi afa so de ako atia anitan ne ahupoo, berɛ a mmara bɔ adasamma yiedie anodisɛm ho ban nti,

folded.id: sɛ ɛkɔba|no|sɛ na asotwe bi wɔ hɔ ansa na asotwe foforɔ a emu yɛ den sene dada no reba a
folded.subject: sɛ ɛkɔba
folded.object: sɛ na asotwe bi wɔ hɔ ansa na asotwe foforɔ a emu yɛ den sene dada no reba a

spans.text: Na sɛ ɛkɔba no sɛ na asotwe bi wɔ hɔ ansa na asotwe foforɔ a emu yɛ den sene dada no reba a, ɛsɛ sɛ asotwe a onii yɛɛ saa bɔne no na ɛwo hɔ dada no ara na wɔde twe no.

folded.id: sɛ mmara|no|bɔ adwumayɔfoɔ ho ban firi adiyie mu
folded.subject: sɛ mmara
folded.object: bɔ adwumayɔfoɔ ho ban firi adiyie mu

spans.text: Ɛnsɛ sɛ mmara no bɔ adwumayɔfoɔ ho ban firi adiyie mu, na ɛhwɛ ma wɔnya ahotɔ wɔ wɔn nnwuma mu.

folded.id: sɛ ɔde|no|fa mmara kwan so ne no di sɛdeɛ mmara seɛ
folded.subject: sɛ ɔde
folded.object: fa mmara kwan so ne no di sɛdeɛ mmara seɛ

spans.text: Sɛ obi bu mmara yi bi so tia ɔfoforɔ a, ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔde no fa mmara kwan so ne no di sɛdeɛ mmara seɛ.

folded.id: sɛ ɔsakra|ne|nkyi nso a
folded.subject: sɛ ɔsakra

spans.text: Sɛ obi pɛ sɛ ɔsakra ne nkyi nso a, ɛyɛ n'asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔsakra berɛ a akwansideɛ biara nni mu.

folded.id: sɛ wɔapae|mu|aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti
folded.subject: sɛ wɔapae
folded.object: aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ atuateɛ ne obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ, na abɛhwanyane nnipa ahonim de asetena foforɔ aba, ama nnipa ani aba wɔn ho so sɛ wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔka wɔn adwene a ehu biara nni mu, na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyɔ adwuma na ɛnhia wɔn, na ɛsiane sɛ wɔapae mu aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti,

folded.id: sɛ wɔde|no|kɔ asɛnniiɛ mpo koraa a
folded.subject: Sɛ wɔde

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde no kɔ asɛnniiɛ mpo koraa a, ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔhwehwɛ mmoa biara a ɔbɛtumi anya de atete ne ho akyiri kwan.

folded.id: sɛ wɔgye|no|to mu sɛ onipa
folded.subject: sɛ wɔgye

spans.text: Sɛ obiara kɔpue mmara anim wɔ baabiara a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔgye no to mu sɛ onipa.

folded.id: sɛ wɔn|a|wɔbɛdi asɛm no bu atɛntenenee
folded.subject: sɛ wɔn

spans.text: Sɛ wɔbɔ obi kwaadu wɔ biribi ho na wɔde onii kɔ asɛnniiɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔbɛdi asɛm no bu atɛntenenee, berɛ a wɔnkyea wɔn aso.

folded.id: sɛ wɔrebu|ne|man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a
folded.subject: sɛ wɔrebu
folded.object: man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a

spans.text: Ɛyɛ onipa biara asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔrebu ne man anaa wɔreka mu asɛm a, ɔka bie.

folded.id: wɔ ahogono|mu|nti
folded.subject: wɔ ahogono

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

folded.id: wɔbɛma asetena|mu|ayɛ yiɛ
folded.subject: wɔbɛma asetena

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo mu nnipa asi wɔn gyidie so dua wɔ Amammuo Nnyinasoɔ no mu, se onipa anim nyam ne boɔ a ɔsom no nye adewa na ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nyinaa yɛ pɛ, na wɔawe ahinam so, sɛ wɔbɛma asetena mu ayɛ yiɛ, na nnipa atumi atena ase sɛ anuanom wɔ ahogono mu nti,

folded.id: wɔde adwene|ne|nyansa na abɔ obiara
folded.subject: wɔde adwene

spans.text: Na wɔde adwene ne nyansa na abɔ obiara.

folded.id: wɔn adwene|a|ehu biara nni mu
folded.subject: wɔn adwene

spans.text: Ɛsiane sɛ atuateɛ ne obuo a wɔammu adasamma yiedie yi de anitan ne atirimuɔden baeɛ, na abɛhwanyane nnipa ahonim de asetena foforɔ aba, ama nnipa ani aba wɔn ho so sɛ wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔka wɔn adwene a ehu biara nni mu, na wɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ wɔyɔ adwuma na ɛnhia wɔn, na ɛsiane sɛ wɔapae mu aka ato dwa sɛ yei ne nnipa anidasoɔ titre nti,

folded.id: wɔn nkyi|ne|wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho
folded.subject: wɔn nkyi
folded.object: wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho

spans.text: Ɛyɛ mmarima ne mmaa a wɔanyinyini, aso awadeɛ asɛdeɛ, sɛ wɔware wowo mma, berɛ a wɔn nipasuo, wɔn nkyi ne wɔn nyamesom nsi wɔn kwan wɔ wɔn awadeɛ anaa awaregyaeɛ ho.

folded.id: wɔnam abatoɔ|a|dwinim biara nni mu
folded.subject: Wɔnam abatoɔ

spans.text: Wɔnam abatoɔ a dwinim biara nni mu, na obi nhunu ne yɔnko abatoɔ mu, na obiara a wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe biara to bie so na ɛdɛdi saa dwuma yi.

folded.id: yɛ bɔne|a|ɛmfa amanyɔ ho anaa ɛntia amanaman nkabom kuo nhyɛhyɛɛ a
folded.subject: yɛ bɔne
folded.object: ɛmfa amanyɔ ho anaa ɛntia Amanaman Nkabom Kuo nhyɛhyɛɛ a

spans.text: Sɛ obi yɛ bɔne a ɛmfa amanyɔ ho anaa ɛntia Amanaman Nkabom Kuo nhyɛhyɛɛ a, ɛnyɛ onii no asɛdeɛ sɛ saa mmara yi bɔ ne ho ban firi saa bɔne no ho.

folded.id: yɛfa|no|sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no
folded.subject: yɛfa
folded.object: sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no

spans.text: Sɛ wɔde so to obi so, nam so kye no, na wɔntumi mfeefee asɛm no mu, nhunuu nokorɛ a ɛwɔ mu a, yɛfa no sɛ onii no nyɛɛ saa bɔne no, gye sɛ wɔnam mmara kwan so, kɔ asɛm no mu, hunu sɛ ɔdi fɔ.
